title: nautilus scene document
description: A 3D process view as data — the spatial sibling of a *.mimic.json P&ID: nodes placed in space, pipes run between them, live tag bindings. Rendered by @joyautomation/nautilus-hmi-3d's <SceneView>, edited as text, diffed and reviewed like the program it belongs to. Positions are METRES in the site frame (the origin marker at [0, 0, 0], +y up), so the file that drives the desktop view is also the file that will place AR overlays. `naut check` runs the same structural rules as this schema, plus the kind ↔ tag-type contract a schema cannot express. Brief: docs/design/spatial-hmi.md.

kinds.description: The kind ↔ struct-type contract (docs/design/spatial-hmi.md §3b): overrides for the built-in kinds (tank → Tank, pump → Motor, valve → Valve) and declarations for kinds the app registers itself. Keyed by kind name. `naut check` holds every node of a declared kind to its `type` and `members`.

environment.description: The surroundings (docs/design/spatial-hmi.md §3c): an HDRI for image-based lighting, optionally as the backdrop, and shadows. Absent = the flat look.

camera.description: Initial camera. Positions in scene metres.

fixtures.description: Static, unbound geometry: the desk, a floor slab, the origin marker.

grid.description: A reference grid on a horizontal plane.

nodes.description: Equipment placed in the scene, each optionally bound to a live tag.

pipes.description: Polylines run between nodes, optionally showing flow state.

writable.description: Reserved: tags an operator may write from this scene. The view is read-only until the write path ships, so a non-empty list is an error rather than a silent no-op — this list must stay empty.

bindingRef.description: A tag reference: an absolute name or dotted path, read from the frame's tag map (`Demand`, `P101.Speed`; no indexing). A leading `!` negates a boolean prop: the prop is `value !== true`. An absent path leaves the prop unset, so the component's default holds.

type.description: The UDT a node of this kind binds. The built-ins default to tank → Tank, pump → Motor, valve → Valve; re-point one here if the project's UDT is named differently.

members.description: The members the kind's component reads off the struct, so `naut check` can hold every node of this kind to the same standard.

model.description: A glTF/GLB as a URL path from the app root (`models/pump.glb` → `/models/pump.glb`; `hmi/static/` in source). Metres, +y up; the node's pos/rot/scale place the model's origin. A data kind under a built-in's name keeps that built-in's contract, status text and faceplate and replaces only the geometry.

component.description: A kind defined by a Svelte component file (docs/design/spatial-hmi.md §3d), as a source path relative to this scene file (`hmi/src/lib/Skid.svelte`). Its default export takes the node's props; its `<script module>` exports `kind` (type, members, bounds, labelAt, status). The app builds it and hands SceneView its modules; the extension lists it in the palette; `naut check` sees the file and holds its nodes to `type`/`members` here.

assembly.description: A kind made of kinds (docs/design/spatial-hmi.md §3d): parts and pipes in the kind's own frame. A part's `tag` is a MEMBER of the assembly's struct (`Pump` inside `SK101` reads `SK101.Pump`), and a ref inside is a path from that struct. Parts are never assemblies.

bounds.description: The halo / selection box: 'auto' (default; the loaded model's box) or an explicit local-space box.

labelAt.description: Where the label floats, local metres. Default: the top centre of the bounds.

status.description: The label's value text as a template over members: `{Level:1} %` → `48.3 %`; `{Running?run:stopped}`. Reads `stale` when quality is bad.

drive.description: What live values do to named meshes in the model. Each drive names one mesh and one channel.

kindContract.description: The UDT ↔ members contract for one kind, and how the document defines it, one way at most: with `model`, a data kind — a glTF whose named meshes the `drive` list moves from the node's struct (docs/design/spatial-hmi.md §3c); with `component`, a kind defined by a Svelte file the app builds (§3d); with `assembly`, a kind made of kinds (§3d).

nodes.description: The parts, as nodes in the kind's own frame (metres from the placed node's origin). A part's `tag` is one member name of the assembly's struct; it has no label unless given, no halo, and a click on it picks the placed node.

pipes.description: Pipes in the kind's own frame; `bind.flowing` is a path from the assembly's struct (`Pump.Running`).

pos.description: Camera position, [x, y, z] metres, site frame.

target.description: Look-at point, [x, y, z] metres, site frame.

fov.description: Vertical field of view, degrees. Default 45.

pos.description: Grid origin, [x, y, z] metres, site frame.

section.description: Heavier line every this many metres. Default 1.

kind.description: Fixture shape: box, plane, or the origin marker.

size.description: box: [w, h, d] metres; plane / marker: [w, d] metres.

texture.description: plane only: PBR maps, so the floor is concrete rather than a colour.

id.description: Unique in the document; what a pick reports.

kind.description: Registry key: 'tank' | 'pump' | 'valve' | one the app registered, or one declared under the document's `kinds`.

tag.description: The struct tag this node binds; the kind's component reads its members.

rot.description: Degrees, XYZ order; [0, yaw, 0] turns the node on the spot.

props.description: Static props passed straight through to the component.

bind.description: Live props: component prop -> ref. Same map and rules as a mimic equipment's `bind`, plus dotted paths for struct members (`P101.Speed`).

points.description: Polyline in scene metres, at least two points.

flowing.description: The one live prop a pipe has, the same key the mimic's pipe binds. Booleans as-is; a number is flowing above 2 (%).

bind.description: A member of the node's struct (`Speed`). The node's own `bind` overrides it by the built-ins' rule (`speed` overrides `Speed`).

numExpr.description: member × scale + offset, clamped to [min, max].

bind.description: A member of the node's struct; true, or a number above `threshold`. A leading `!` negates.

threshold.description: A number counts as true above this. Default 0.

mesh.description: The name of a mesh (node) in the model.

spin.description: Turn the mesh continuously about its local axis, at revPerS revolutions per second.

turn.description: Set the mesh's rotation about its local axis, degrees from the model's own.

scale.description: Set the mesh's scale on that axis (a fluid whose origin is its base).

bind.description: A member of the node's struct; true, or a number above `threshold`. A leading `!` negates.

threshold.description: A number counts as true above this. Default 0.

on.description: A palette slot (`running`, `fluid`, `handle`, `stale`, a priority name) or a CSS colour.

off.description: A palette slot (`running`, `fluid`, `handle`, `stale`, a priority name) or a CSS colour. Absent = the model's own colour.

tint.description: The mesh's colour is `on` while true, else `off` or the model's own.

bind.description: A member of the node's struct; true, or a number above `threshold`. A leading `!` negates.

threshold.description: A number counts as true above this. Default 0.

on.description: A palette slot (`running`, `fluid`, `handle`, `stale`, a priority name) or a CSS colour.

visible.description: The mesh is shown while true.

drive.description: One mesh, one channel: spin, turn, scale, tint, emissive or visible. The vocabulary is fixed (docs/design/spatial-hmi.md §3c); a kind that needs more is a Svelte component in the registry.

hdri.description: An equirectangular .hdr or .exr as a URL path from the app root (`env/workshop_1k.hdr`). CC0 1k files from Poly Haven are the size the brief allows in git.

backdrop.description: What you SEE when `background` is on: a larger equirect image (a tonemapped .jpg/.png, or another .hdr/.exr) in place of the HDRI, so lighting comes from a small file and the backdrop from a sharp one.

background.description: `none` (default): the HDRI lights and reflects only. `sky`: it is the backdrop. `ground`: it is projected onto a floor at `floor`, so a desk-scale scene stands in it.

floor.description: The floor's y for `ground`, metres. Default 0.

color.description: CSS colour the distance fades toward. Default: a neutral grey.

near.description: Metres at which the fade starts. Default 4.

far.description: Metres at which it is fully the colour. Default 14.

fog.description: Distance fade toward a colour, so the far backdrop and the projected floor soften deliberately instead of reading as a low-res photo.

shadows.description: A shadow-casting key light with soft shadows (the desktop tier).

environment.description: The surroundings: an HDRI, the backdrop and shadows.

map.description: The colour map, a URL path from the app root.

texture.description: PBR maps for a plane (a concrete floor). Loaded only in the lit look.
